name: Alessia Bellini
bio:
Alessia Bellini is a seasoned paint shop specialist with a passion for motorsport that ignited early in her life, watching Formula 1 races with her father. Her career began in automotive restoration, where she honed her skills in color matching and precision application. After a decade, she transitioned to karting, drawn by the vibrant energy and constant innovation of the sport. 

Alessia's approach to painting is meticulous and driven by a desire for perfection. She believes that the paint job is more than just aesthetics; it's a reflection of the team's dedication and attention to detail. She prides herself on her ability to create flawless finishes that not only look stunning but also provide aerodynamic advantages. Her innovative approach to materials and techniques sets her apart, constantly seeking new ways to improve the performance and appearance of the karts.

At Junior Kart Team, Alessia is known for her unwavering commitment and her ability to work under pressure. She is a valuable asset, consistently delivering high-quality results while maintaining a positive and collaborative attitude.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, styled in soft waves with a side part.
physical.description: Alessia is a woman of medium height with a warm smile and a kind face.

quirks: Always listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Keeps a small espresso machine in her workshop and offers everyone a shot.
Insists on using only natural light when color-matching, even if it means opening the garage door on a cold day.
